title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
summary: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.

title: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
summary: A newly created wallet drained hot and cold reserves labeled as belonging to Bitget across multiple blockchains in under an hour.

title: In Her Final Weeks, SEC's Peirce Calls for Ending the KYC 'Panopticon'
summary: In one of her final speeches as commissioner, Peirce argued that regulators' "data haystacks" endanger the people they aim to protect—as recent KYC leaks expose crypto holders to phishing and physical attacks.

title: US Aims to Turn Stablecoins Into a Weapon for Dollar Dominance
summary: Washington may fund private stablecoin ventures abroad to protect the dollar's reserve status and prop up Treasury demand.

title: Bitcoin Breakout Cools as Fed Rate-Hike Bets Climb
summary: Bitcoin has slipped back below $85,000 after tagging an eight-month high near $87,400 last week, with rising odds of an October Fed hike taking some air out of the rally.

title: £10K Reward Offered After UK Couple Attacked in Crypto Home Invasion
summary: Police believe the robbery was planned and targeted, with instructions relayed to the three attackers by a fourth man on a video call.

title: Solana Foundation Hires Binance's Former Global CMO for Institutional Push
summary: Rachel Conlan arrives as chief strategy officer and Polygon Labs' Jamal Raees takes over payments, both recruited from elsewhere in crypto.

title: Elliptic Wants Every Cop to Read a Crypto Wallet in Seconds—With AI
summary: Elliptic’s new AI-assisted tool, called Pulse, lets any officer input a wallet address or transaction hash and get a plain-language summary in seconds, aiming to bring crypto tracing beyond specialized units.

title: Morning Minute: Selig Says ‘It’s Go Time’ for CFTC Crypto Rules
summary: The CFTC has been extremely busy ever since the Clarity Act failed its vote, and it appears they’re ready to accelerate.

title: $15.6 Billion in Bitcoin Options Expire Friday—Here's What It Means
summary: Deribit's strike-by-strike data shows a book stacked with calls, and one price level drawing hedging pressure from both sides at once.

title: Borrow Against Your Bitcoin at a Fixed Rate: Coinbase Expands Morpho Loans
summary: The product lets users lock in their rate and repayment date when borrowing USDC against Bitcoin, marking the first enterprise-scale deployment of Morpho Midnight and a shift away from on-chain lending's variable-rate norm.

title: Crypto Exchange That Invented 100x Leverage Is No More: Here’s What BitMEX Users Need to Know
summary: BitMEX ended trading at 04:00 UTC Wednesday and is urging users to withdraw their remaining funds, as fees now apply to balances left on the exchange.

title: NYSE Taps Blockchain.com to Reach Crypto Investors With Tokenized Stocks
summary: Blockchain.com and NYSE Group signed a preliminary agreement to give the crypto exchange's users access to tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, pending regulatory approval.

title: Americans Would Use Stablecoins—If They Came With Bank Protections, Visa Study Finds
summary: A Visa survey found U.S. willingness to use stablecoins for cross-border transfers rises from 36% to 56% when paired with hypothetical bank-level fraud protection and deposit insurance.

title: Bitcoin Dips, But Its Forks Are Flying Again
summary: A CME futures listing and a fresh Grayscale ETF filing sent Bitcoin's two biggest forks soaring, even as the flagship coin cooled off its seven-month high.

title: BlackRock: AI Agents Could Drive Crypto's Next Demand Wave
summary: The world's largest asset manager argues that autonomous AI agents buying data, paying for services, and renting computing power could quietly become one of the biggest forces pushing money into crypto.
